common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.conflict: That is already taken. Try something else.
errors.tenantOffline: This shop is not open right now.
errors.planLimited: This is not available on your current plan.

signIn.title: Welcome to Lytro
signIn.lead: Enter your phone number to continue. New or returning, this is the only door.
signIn.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number
signIn.freeSmsNote: Signing in by code to an existing shop uses one of the shop's free SMS. Password sign-in is free.

verify.title: Verify your number
verify.validFor: The code is valid for {{minutes}} minutes.
verify.expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.

createShop.title: Create your shop
createShop.lead: Pick a name and a link. The link is set once and never changes.
createShop.linkRule: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 30 characters.
createShop.linkInvalid: Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.
createShop.linkReserved: This link cannot be given out. Pick another one.
createShop.refused: A shop was already opened from this account or internet connection recently. Nothing was created; everything you typed is kept.
createShop.alreadyHasShop: This account already has a shop. One shop per account.

checkout.title: Get your plan
checkout.lead: Your shop is ready. Pay for the plan now, or continue on the trial without paying.
checkout.noRefund: A started period is not refunded.
checkout.sendAmount: Send {{amount}} to one of these numbers:
checkout.noWalletsYet: No payment numbers are set yet. Contact support, or take a plan later from the dashboard.
checkout.submitted: Payment submitted. The plan starts once it is verified; we will let you know.
checkout.submittedNext: Until then your shop runs on the trial; nothing is blocked.
checkout.noPlans: No plan is on sale right now. Your shop continues on the trial.
checkout.balanceTooLow: The balance does not cover it; send from a wallet below.

setPassword.title: Set a password
setPassword.lead: Optional. You can always sign in with a code; a password lets you in without an SMS.
setPassword.leadRequired: A new password is needed to continue.
setPassword.rulesNotMet: The password does not meet the rules.
setPassword.facebookOnly: Your account was created with Facebook only, with no phone or email. The only way back in is signing in with that same Facebook account. You can add a phone number later from settings.

staffSetPassword.lead: Your shop owner set a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

setUp.title: Set up your shop
setUp.lead: Two questions, both skippable and changeable later.
setUp.homeAreaHint: Your two delivery zones are built from this.
setUp.zonesNote: Both charges can be changed later in settings, and zones can be added.

staffSignIn.title: Staff sign-in
staffSignIn.lead: Sign in with the phone number and password your shop owner gave you.
staffSignIn.forgotNote: Forgot the password? Ask the owner; they can set a new one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter your phone number and we will send a reset code.

lifecycle.trialWhatHappens: At day 30 you continue on pay-as-you-go; nothing is lost.
lifecycle.renewByDays_one: Renew within {{count}} day to avoid restrictions.
lifecycle.renewByDays_other: Renew within {{count}} days to avoid restrictions.
lifecycle.readOnlyNotice: Your shop is read-only until you renew: you can view and export, not change.
lifecycle.lockedNotice: Your shop is locked. Only the owner can sign in, to renew or export.
lifecycle.archivedNotice: Your shop is archived. Take a plan or choose pay-as-you-go to bring it back.

notFound.title: Shop not found
notFound.lead: There is no shop at this address, or it is not yours.

offline.title: The shop is not open right now

suspended.title: Your shop is not available right now

lockedOut.title: Renew and the shop opens again
lockedOut.lead: All your data is here. Take a plan or choose pay-as-you-go.

home.title: Home
home.paymentBeingChecked: Your payment is being checked. The plan name appears here once it is active.

checklist.title: Get your shop ready
checklist.moreLater: Products, logo, payment numbers and couriers join this list as those features go live.

today.title: Today
today.empty: Your first order will appear here. Share the link on your page.

orders.emptyLead: When the first order arrives, you confirm it and book the courier here.

products.emptyLead: The add-product form is coming to this section; you will add your first product from here.

customers.emptyLead: Your customer list builds here after the first order.

balance.emptyLead: Top-ups for SMS and paid features are coming to this section.

wallet.howTo: Send Money from your own number, then enter the sender number and the TrxID from the SMS.
wallet.fillBoth: Enter the sender number and the TrxID.

balance.frozenNote: The shop is closed, so the balance is frozen. Take a plan or choose pay-as-you-go to use it again.
balance.pendingTopUpNote: It is added once the payment is matched, usually within an hour. We will tell you.

type.carry_over: Carried over from the earlier shop

rates.title: Current rates
rates.since: Rates since {{date}}. A change shows here first; past entries never change.

balance.boundsHint: Added once the payment is matched. The platform sets a minimum and a maximum per top-up.
balance.buys: {{amount}} covers about {{sms}} SMS parts, or {{ai}} chat replies.

figures.renewFromNow: renew: a new period from now

plan.autoRenewNote: On {{date}}, {{amount}} is taken from your balance if it covers it.
plan.autoRenewNoteShort: Taken from your balance at period end if it covers it.

banner.afterEnd: After that the shop goes read-only, then locks. Nothing is deleted for 60 days.
banner.locked: Shop locked · day {{days}} after the period ended
banner.archived: Shop archived · day {{days}} after the period ended
banner.reopens: Customers see a closed sign. Renew, or choose pay-as-you-go, and it reopens within a minute.

plan.paygLimitsNote: Smaller limits than Starter; no monthly fee and no period.
plan.paygNow: Pay-as-you-go is on. The shop is open again.
plan.paygAtPeriodEnd: You move to pay-as-you-go when the current period ends.
plan.upgradeStarts: The new plan starts the moment the payment is confirmed and runs {{months}} months from then. Limits rise at once.
plan.purchaseStarts: The plan starts once the payment is confirmed.
plan.upgradePaid: Upgraded. The new limits apply now.
plan.purchasePaid: Paid from the balance. The plan is active.
plan.downgradeHappens: Happens on {{date}}, when the current plan ends. Nothing changes and nothing is charged before then.
plan.overLimitConsequence: Existing products keep selling; you cannot add new ones until you are under the limit. You choose which staff stay active; nobody is deleted.
plan.nothingOver: Everything you use fits the new limits.
plan.stopLead: The plan runs until {{date}} either way. After that the shop goes read-only, then locks, and is deleted after 60 days unless you come back.
plan.cancelConfirmLead: It ends on {{date}}. You can undo this any time before then.
plan.cancelSuccess: The plan ends when the period does
plan.closeShopLead: Pay-as-you-go has no period. Closing archives the shop at once and freezes the balance; come back within 60 days and everything is kept.
plan.closeConfirmLead: The shop is archived at once and the balance is frozen. Taking a plan or choosing pay-as-you-go within 60 days brings it back.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.pdfLater: Download as PDF arrives with the next billing update.

team.title: Team
team.seatsFull: All seats are in use. Deactivate someone, or upgrade for more seats.
team.nobodyDeleted: Deactivating keeps a person's history in the activity log and frees the seat. Nobody is ever deleted.
team.phoneHint: They sign in with this number. It must not be on another account.
team.firstPasswordHint: Tell them this. They must change it at their first sign-in.
team.activeNote: Off ends their sessions now and frees the seat.
team.noRolesYet: No roles yet. Create one under Roles.
team.laterPermissions: Changes apply on each person's next tap, no re-sign-in needed. Orders, products and customers arrive with those sections.
team.permissionsApplyNext: A role change applies on the person's next tap.
team.deleteRoleLead: Nobody holds it. This cannot be undone.

permissionNote.balanceManage: Send money to the platform wallet

activity.title: Activity
activity.lead: Who did what in this shop. {{plan}} keeps it for its retention period; money entries 24 months.

sentence.plan_assigned: put the shop on a plan
sentence.lifecycle_state_changed: moved the shop to a new state
sentence.subscription_cancelled: cancelled the subscription at period end
sentence.purchase_placed: placed a purchase with the supplier

settings.title: Shop settings
settings.contactLead: Shown in the shop's footer and on its contact page.
settings.zonesHint: Set at sign-up; the editor arrives with the delivery section.
settings.extraPerKgHint: Added per kilogram past the first, only for products with weight-based delivery. 0 adds nothing.
settings.name: Name
settings.brandingLater: Name, logo and shop type move here with the branding section.

account.title: Sign-in and security
account.lead: The ways into your account. Keep two, so you are never locked out.
account.noPhoneSub: Codes by SMS could also come here
account.noEmailSub: Codes and invoices could also go here
account.keepOne: Keep at least one way in
account.codeNotePhone: A 6-digit code arrives by SMS; enter it here and the number is yours.
account.codeNoteEmail: A 6-digit code arrives in the email; enter it here and the address is yours.
account.recoveryNote: Forgot your password? A code goes to your phone by SMS or to your email. With only Facebook, Facebook is the only way back.
